description: This file contains methods for exporting boards and related data into a zip archive, including writing version info, boards, blocks, members, and associated files.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct with methods for exporting data

methods.name: ExportArchive
methods.description: Exports specified boards and their data into a zip archive, including version info, blocks, members, and files.

methods.name: writeArchiveVersion
methods.description: Writes a version.json file into the archive with version and timestamp.

methods.name: writeArchiveBoard
methods.description: Writes a single board and its related blocks, members, and files into the archive.

methods.name: writeArchiveBoardMemberLine
methods.description: Serializes a board member into the archive.

methods.name: writeArchiveBlockLine
methods.description: Serializes a block into the archive.

methods.name: writeArchiveBoardLine
methods.description: Serializes a board into the archive.

methods.name: writeArchiveFile
methods.description: Writes a file associated with a board into the archive.

methods.name: getBoardsForArchive
methods.description: Fetches board data for given board IDs.
